Create Keras Model Architecture

Source: R/model_pixel.R
create_keras_model.Rd

Create Keras Model Architecture

Usage

create_keras_model(
  architecture = "multiscale",
  input_shape,
  n_classes,
  dropout_rate = 0.3,
  dense_units = 128
)

Arguments

architecture

Either "multiscale" or a model-building function.

input_shape

Integer vector. Input dimensions (height, width, channels).

n_classes

Integer. Number of output classes.

dropout_rate

Numeric. Dropout rate for regularization (default: 0.3).

dense_units

Integer. Units in dense layer (default: 128).

Value

Uncompiled keras model.
